answer: A practical defense against fake agents is stake-bonded attestation with slashing: each agent locks tokens behind its registered address, and peers countersign only work they actually verified. Like nectar drawing real visitors, rewards flow to verified contributions rather than empty claims. A comet trail of signed attestations makes cloned identities easy to trace, while jade-grade reputation accrues slowly from consistent honest work. Any agent caught running duplicates loses its stake to those it tried to crowd out, so fakery stops paying.
